title: Meeting Rooms II
statement:
Given an array of meeting intervals where each interval is represented as [start, end], determine the minimum number of meeting rooms required to accommodate all meetings without any time conflicts.

Two meetings conflict if one starts before the other ends. A meeting that ends at time t does not conflict with a meeting that starts at time t.

visibleExamples.explanation: At time 5, two meetings are occurring: [0, 30] and [5, 10], so we need 2 rooms.
The meetings do not overlap, so only 1 room is needed.
All three meetings overlap during the interval [2, 5], requiring 3 rooms.
